case: a file_set whose names are in double quotes, as Metashape writes them
why: Metashape writes mtllib "Tile 93341-516978.mtl" and map_Kd "Tile 93341-516978.jpg" when a name has spaces. The quotes are not part of the name: the members are the same three files a name without quotes would call (found by 3DSC for Metashape on the San Pietro blocks; until 0.1.3 the mtl was 'missing'). The neighbour tile's texture stays out and is named.

Tile 93341-516978.obj.text:
# Metashape block
mtllib "Tile 93341-516978.mtl"
v 0 0 0
v 1 0 0
v 0 1 0
vt 0 0
vt 1 0
vt 0 1
usemtl Solid
f 1/1 2/2 3/3
